config firewall policy
    edit 230679
        set name "netops-g23-679"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003
        set srcintf "host01"
        set dstintf "host01"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "netops-g23-679-vip"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL_TCP"
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
    next
end
